cell_type.evidence: inferred: c-Jun N-terminal kinases (JNKs) are implicated in both neurodegeneration and mood regulation, including anxiety and depressive-like behaviours.

disease_state.evidence: inferred: JNK inhibition reduced anxiety-like behaviour and significantly altered 163 and 97 phosphosites in the hippocampus and nucleus accumbens, respectively.

material_type.evidence: inferred: Mice underwent intracerebral (ICV) infusion with DJNKI-1 or control TAT peptide for six weeks, after which behaviours were assessed and phosphoproteomic profiling performed.

sample_source.evidence: inferred: A total amount of 200 μg of protein extract from Hippocampi and NAc were loaded onto 12 % TGX Criterion Gel (Bio-Rad Laboratories, Hercules, Ca, USA) for in-gel proteomic analysis.
